definitions.explanation: Reducing the time needed for a task or activity. Short for {時間短縮|じかんたんしゅく}. Very commonly used in everyday life, especially about cooking, housework, and work tasks.
Reduced operating hours, especially of restaurants and shops. Became extremely common during COVID-19 when businesses were asked to close early.

examples.japanese: {時短|じたん}レシピを{探|さが}す。
{時短|じたん}のために{食洗機|しょくせんき}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a dishwasher to save time.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{準備|じゅんび}を{時短|じたん}するコツを{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me some tips for cutting down on morning preparation time.

examples.japanese: {時短営業|じたんえいぎょう}のお{知|し}らせ。
あの{店|みせ}は{今|いま}{時短|じたん}で{夜|よる}8{時|じ}に{閉|し}まる。
examples.english: That shop is on shortened hours and closes at 8 PM now.

examples.japanese: {時短要請|じたんようせい}に{応|おう}じて、{営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}を{短縮|たんしゅく}しました。
examples.english: In response to the request to shorten hours, we reduced our operating hours.

notes: Abbreviation of {時間短縮|じかんたんしゅく}. Can function as a noun modifier: {時短|じたん}レシピ (quick recipe), {時短|じたん}テク (time-saving technique), {時短|じたん}グッズ (time-saving goods). Also used with する: {時短|じたん}する (to save time). The sense of 'shortened business hours' became widespread during the COVID-19 pandemic, often appearing in {時短営業|じたんえいぎょう} (reduced-hours operation) and {時短要請|じたんようせい} (request to shorten hours).
